title: Cymbergaj
tagline: Slide the paddle. Strike the brass puck. Score at the far end.
description: The Polish puck table duel. Slide your paddle, strike the brass puck, bank it off the rail and score past five computer rivals or a friend on the same phone. A calm mode, a Hint and Watch & Learn help you get better.
howToPlay: Slide a finger on your half of the table and your paddle follows.
Strike the puck with a moving paddle: the faster the paddle, the faster the puck.
Score by getting the puck into the goal at the far end, between the two posts.
Use the side rails for bank shots; the paddles never cross the middle line.
First to 5 goals (or 7 in a full match) wins; the side that conceded serves.
